title: The member right rail starts 40px wider than the left (288px against 248px) so the Feed's three columns balance

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14: the rail alignment is still even; make the right one slightly wider.

detail: Both rails defaulted to 248px (members-shell.css --fqm-l / --fqm-r, rail-layout.tsx DEFAULT_W), so with the right rail carrying the heavier panels the Feed read off centre. The right rail's default is now 288px (--fqm-r and DEFAULT_R for the drag start); the left stays 248px. A member who already dragged a rail keeps their own saved width, and the 220 to 320px range is unchanged.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const c=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/members-shell.css','utf8'),r=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/shell/rail-layout.tsx','utf8');if(!c.includes('--fqm-r:288px')||!r.includes('const DEFAULT_R = 288')){console.error('SCAN-897: the right rail still defaults to the left rail width');process.exit(1)}"
